I can understand and communicate in multiple languages. Specifically, I support 100 languages, including but not limited to: Chinese, English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and many others.

If you have any content that needs translation or communication, feel free to let me know anytime!
